item.title: Encroachment alters river courses, blocks drainage in Paradip

item.title: Indian American Pulkit Desai sworn in as New Jersey City mayor
item.description: Washington: Pulkit Desai, a US Marine veteran and technology professional, has been sworn in as mayor of Parsippany, New Jersey, becoming the township’s first Indian American mayor after a razor-thin election victory. Desai, a Democrat, won the mayoral race after provisional and vote-by-mail ballots overturned an earlier lead held by Republican incumbent James Barberio. Final […]
